decisions.reason: Strong external validation from the UK Home Office and 30 APIS schemes has resolved uncertainty favorably, so the option is kept and further supported.
The travel health API remains a low-cost option with uncertain prospects, so it is kept open while results are monitored.
Behavior analysis is still uncertain and only mentioned, but its low cost from building on established capabilities makes it an option worth holding.
The travel and document verification platform fits the firm's established verification services and has a dedicated page, so it is kept open while results develop.
